question: Among drivers who set a Q2 time starting with '1:40' in race No. 355, find the one with the fastest lap time across all races. Return their full name and nationality.

WITH eligible_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT q.XCL_058 AS driver_id
    FROM qualifying q
    WHERE q.XCL_057 = 355
      AND q.XCL_063 LIKE '1:40%'
),
fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT
        lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id,
        MIN(lt.XCL_048) AS min_lap_ms
    FROM lapTimes lt
    WHERE lt.XCL_048 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY lt.XCL_044
)
SELECT
    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    d.XCL_041 AS nationality
FROM eligible_drivers ed
INNER JOIN fastest_laps fl ON ed.driver_id = fl.driver_id
INNER JOIN drivers d ON d.XCL_034 = ed.driver_id
ORDER BY fl.min_lap_ms ASC
LIMIT 1
